display_name: 更新CVS网络的Phase1修复：时序门控与学习率固定对照32行
description: 从代码和源日志发现的问题出发，2×2门控/学习率对照及CE、LEO、独立域对抗、MixStyle适配验证；全部固定对照从零训练，不按历史目标成绩筛选。
authorization: 用户2026-10-08：修复优化方案，适配现在的更新的网络，跑实验验证。 用户2026-10-08 08时明确追加：直接启动。允许接管本run尚未启动worker的等待控制器，使用空闲GPU立即开跑；原R5/R6健康任务不动。

data.representation: equalized=1; center256; unit packet RMS; fs=25000000Hz
data.tx_sets_ref: ManySig.tx_list: all6; actual physical class strings exported at runtime
data.leo_config_ref: native practical_adapter and frozen matched recipe; supervised concat unless row ablates it; separate DAOT/MUSE views as declared

permissions.query_use: frozen Phase1 inference only; separate truth-last scorer
permissions.claim_scope: BENCHMARK_INFORMED_FIXED_DESIGN: user-fixed architecture on exposed benchmark; no fresh blind architecture-selection claim. No test feedback into tuning, selection or selective rerun.

checkpoint.initialization: Every row scratch; own scratch EMA only
checkpoint.selection_rule: Own fixed E200 for every preregistered control; no matrix ranking/filtering; all32 freeze before any query

execution.gpu_policy: Direct start on wholly idle GPU; max4 new workers; count all pre-CUDA reservations; preserve total<=2/GPU and existing healthy workers
execution.stop_rule: Nonfinite loss/gradient, source or target permission violation, output collision or nonzero exit fails only affected row; no low-performance stop, automatic retry, fallback or unrelated intervention.

metrics_plan.primary: Accuracy/Macro-F1, fourseed mean/sampleSD, worstRX, fixedpairedseed contrasts, allRX/TX confusion matrices
primary_comparisons: bank vs batch at each LR
cosine vs constant at each gate

notes: Diagnostic repair is not an established performance gain. All negatives retained.
LEO source mechanism is retained from original SOURCE-only continuation choice; no prior target ranking used.
No V updates or Vcal/Vselect split. Original L/U/V physical roles reused.
Architecture remains reference_response; no legacy checkpoint or source-domain inherited model states.
Historical benchmark exposed: descriptive repeated benchmark validation, not untouched blind confirmation.
Phase2 adaptation/K/new classes N/A; this is Phase1 only.
Old healthy R5/R6 and evaluators are not stopped or modified.
Direct-start handoff supersedes WAITING_PRIOR_OWNERS. Only own idle repair owner is replaced after exact identity/artifact checks; no scientific config/weight/seed changes.

stage_policies.lr: constant2e-4 or cosine E1=2e-4 E200=1e-6 for all optimizer groups
stage_policies.bank: same U physical ID consistent across >=2 consecutive high-confidence epochs; no U truth; no target bank
stage_policies.domain: legacy lambda_domain=1 lambda_adv=.35; pseudo_domain_gate false in every row
stage_policies.mixstyle: existing reference adapter time_down,t1; unchanged .18/.1/.7; response branch bypass is retained and documented
